summary: Diff implements Twin Roots Foods rebrand in header/footer, updates Home hero headline/copy and hero image, adds export-focused homepage sections (per provided file summary), embeds a reusable ExportInquiryForm, and adds WhatsApp entry points in header/footer and (per summary) Home contact section. No clear evidence of broken routes or backend/service changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Adds WhatsApp as a secondary contact action in the site header and footer (not strictly required; header/footer placement was optional).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-15 requires a WhatsApp button in the Home page Contact section; header/footer placement is described as optional, so adding it is extra beyond the minimum requested behavior.
